name: Kevin Kiley
page_title: Kevin Kiley's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Independent for U.S. House (CA) - District 6

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee
Voted in favor of HR 26 "Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act"
La Times "During a debate ahead of the primaries before Roe vs. Wade was overturned, Kiley said he would "fight for pro-life policies."'

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: Rated 48% by Health Access California
Voted against AB 414 "Establishes a Statewide Individual Mandate Program for Health Insurance"

LA Times "I’m not sure it’s necessary to be continually specifying what every single plan needs to entail," Kiley told the outlet. "I don’t know that legislators are always in the best position to be weighing in."
"The federal government must uphold its commitment to our nation’s seniors. I will vote against any cuts to Social Security or Medicare benefits."

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "I will work to decrease taxes on middle-class families, seniors and small businesses."
Voted against AB 1253 "Increases Income Taxes For People Who Earn More Than $1 Million"

positions.question: Do you support a wealth tax in order to pay for public programs?

evidence.text: "Despite a plethora of coauthors, the wealth tax and income tax hike both died. Some ideas are too nutty even for California, at least for the moment."
Rated 100% by Americans for Prosperity

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: Voted against SB 1360 "Amends the California Election Code to Require Transparency of Contributors and Advertisements"

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: Voted against AB 481 "Requires Law Enforcement Agencies Receive Approval Before Acquiring Military-Grade Equipment"
Voted in favor of H Con Res 40 "Expressing support for local law enforcement officers and condemning efforts to defund or dismantle local law enfo ..."
LA Times "Strong supporter of our law enforcement and the important role it plays in keeping us safe."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: Voted in favor of HR 4365 "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2024"

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "I promised to do everything in my power to rein in the excessive federal spending that created the inflation crisis crushing California families. With today’s vote for the Fiscal Responsibility Act, we made a $2.1 trillion down payment on that promise – the largest single deficit reduction in U.S. history."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "There is a simple reason homelessness in California has spiraled out-of-control despite insane levels of spending: political ineptitude. The proof is that San Francisco was able to clean up the city immediately to welcome China's President Xi. It's a matter of political will."
Voted in favor of AB 2011 "Establishes Affordable Housing and High Road Jobs Act"

LA Times "While homelessness is not just a housing issue, there is no doubt that California has an affordability crisis. We need to eliminate the overregulation that makes housing so difficult and costly to build."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Finally, the Secretary of Defense is authorized to provide monthly bonuses to junior enlisted members to mitigate the impacts of inflation."
"When I ran for Congress, I promised to do everything in my power to rein in the excessive federal spending that created the inflation crisis crushing California families."
Voted in favor of HR 347 "Reduce Exacerbated Inflation Negatively Impacting the Nation Act"
"Out-of-control government spending has left Californians struggling under the weight of runaway inflation and an ever-increasing cost of living."

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "For example, on student loan forgiveness, President Biden originally said, 'I don't think I have the authority to do it,' and then went ahead and did it anyway by executive order. The Supreme Court, of course, recently struck that order down. With the new Congress declining to pass further harmful economic policies, the administration has increasingly relied on aggressive agency rulemaking."
Arkansas Advocate "The following month they supported a joint resolution disapproving of the student loan debt cancellation plan."
Voted in favor of AB 1746 "Expands Grant Programs to Reduce College Debt"

evidence.text: Despite exhaustive research, Vote Smart was unable to find information about this candidate's position.

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "It is going to lower costs for Americans and, in particular, my State of California, where we pay the highest energy costs in the country. It will do that by lowering utility bills, by reducing gas prices, and by reducing the cost of everyday goods by reducing the cost of transport. It will do this by making our country more energy independent, enhancing our capacity for domestic energy production."

"Yesterday the California Energy Commission voted 5-0 to approve a new community solar program that will allow homeowners in SMUD territory to reap the benefits of solar energy without having to bear the cost of panels on each and every roof. I was happy to testify in support of this new program, which demonstrates that affordability and a clean energy future can coexist."
Voted in favor of HR 4394 "Energy and Water Development and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2024"
